sentences.en: Will it be hard to get a consensus in Algeria?
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚达成共识会很难吗？

sentences.en: There is no consensus on what is meant by conscience.
sentences.zh: 人们对良心的含义并没有取得一致意见。

sentences.en: The consensus indicates that we are opposed to the proposed idea.
sentences.zh: 根据共识，我们反对这个提议的想法。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+sens（感觉）+ us→感觉相同→一致
